summary: Delete a property reference with ToPropertyKey, configurability, strict-mode, and Proxy semantics.

semantics.receiver: GetValue base/object rules; property key ToPropertyKey
semantics.configurable: ordinary configurable own property is removed; non-configurable delete returns false
semantics.strict_mode: failure throws TypeError instead of returning false

caveats: Deleting an inherited property reports true while the inherited lookup remains visible.

tests.name: delete configurable own property
tests.input: const x={a:1}; console.log(delete x.a,'a' in x);
